name: Up to 99 Cutting Tools/Soap/Cloth
description: Cutting tools and cloth bolts can be stored up to 99 instead of 6. They are still made 3 at a time (a villager at the fish skeleton makes 3 cutting tools, a villager storing finished cloth adds 3 bolts), and every use takes one as before; the count never goes above 99. The stock game also put the count back to 6 whenever one was used: no longer. Soap was never limited to 6 in the stock game, so it needs no change. The stacked pictures look exactly as with 6 when more are stored: the row of cutting tools shows at most 6, the Clothing Hut at most 6 bolts, and the soap at most 3 bars, as in the normal game. Pointing at the cutting tools or the Clothing Hut still shows how many there are ("Cutting tools left: 23"). The count is the game's own, saved in the save as before (a whole number, so 99 saves and loads as it is). **Needs no other patch.** **Off by default; Owner's Defaults ticks it.** Without the patch, a save holding more than 6 keeps its count until the next use puts it back to 6, as the normal game does. **Unverified in play: the effect has not been tested live.** The companion is "VVFP VV4 Supply Cap.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; if the DLL cannot be loaded, the stock game runs.
behavior_changes: Cutting tools (object 0x4D8614, count 0x4D8618) and cloth bolts (0x4D8AC8, count 0x4D8ACC): their produce routines (0x431400, 0x436890: += 3) cap at 99 instead of 6 (0x43142F, 0x4368E2), and the shared use-up 0x4369F0 clamps at 99 instead of 6 after each use (0x436A09).
The cutting tools' stack (0x431480, sprite 0x18, three to a row) and the Clothing Hut's bolts (0x430C80, cloth_bolt) draw min(count, 6) pictures.
explicit_non_changes: Soap (object 0x4D8D90, count 0x4D8D98) is not changed: the stock game never caps it (0x43A2DF += 3, use-up 0x43A410 with no upper clamp) and draws at most 3 bars (0x43A347).

Production stays 3 at a time; every use (the cutting-tool harvest, job events 53 and 54, the tree decoration, the pruning puzzle) takes one as before; the achievements count what was made, never the store; the tooltips print the real count.
The counts are saved and loaded as one dword each by the game's own save (0x436870 / 0x4313E0), with no clamp; nothing else is written.
No executable byte is patched: the companion writes its 3 byte changes and 2 jumps at run time, only after verifying every stock byte, all or none.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly; emulated (produce to 99 and never 100, a use keeps 98, the stacks as with 6, the stock game without the patch) in tests/test_vv4_supply_cap.py; runtime/player confirmation pending
